data.name: Swimming Master
data.description: You gain a swim speed equal to your base land speed and a +8 racial bonus on Swim checks. If you already have a swim speed, your base swim speed increases by 30 feet. You can hold your breath for %1 minutes, but afterward you must succeed at checks as normal to avoid drowning. If you expend one use of mythic power, for 1 hour your base swim speed increases by %2 feet.|Ability_SwimmingMaster_Breath|Ability_SwimmingMaster_Speed
